reason: The goal is to free the array, and the hand winch seems suited to pulling the buried pallet free.
expectation: I expect the winch to help uncover or move the pallet, though it may need preparation first.

alternatives.reason: The service tool might open or dismantle the shipping frame, but the winch seems more directly connected to the buried pallet.

effect: The array is recovered, but its narrow brackets need broader feet before it can stand on the loose ground. The shipping frame can provide the material.
reaction: It is satisfying to recover the array, and the explanation of why it needs broader feet makes the next step clear.
reason: The shipping frame has material for the feet, and using the service tool on it is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect to salvage usable pieces from the frame, though I do not know their exact form.

effect: The shipping frame has become stock that can be shaped around the array to support it.
reaction: The explanation makes the salvaged material's purpose clear, though the next step is predictable.
reason: The stock can form the broad feet the array needs, and this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect to make a more stable support for the array, though it may need further work before it can power the cabin.

effect: The array is now standing, so connecting it is the next apparent step toward powering the cabin.
reaction: The support came together as expected; it is a satisfying, straightforward result.
reason: The power lead is the natural way to connect the standing array, and this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the lead to connect the array for cabin power, though another connection may still be needed.

effect: The solar rack powers the heater, completing the cabin power goal and letting the emergency battery rest.
reaction: Hearing the cabin fan settle into its ordinary note makes the restored power feel tangible and satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the array stand was most worthwhile: salvaging the shipping frame for wide feet connected the build to the practical problem of loose ground.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the frame into stock was clear but predictable, with only one combination offered.

surprise.text: I had not expected the shipping frame to provide the broad feet needed to keep the array from sinking.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to recovering, supporting, or connecting the array.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the practical problem-solving was satisfying, and I am curious how the expedition develops.
